GOPT.name: Guarantee Of Payment

DFCL.name: Deferred Clearing
DFCL.definition: DeferredClearing identifies transactions, like ones related to health care system, that allows a delay in clearing which ensure the payer to be refunded by a system, for example an insurance, before its bank account is debited.
